Done. I added a `workdir` argument to the server so a client can dictate the default directory when no `cwd` is passed to a `run_xonsh` call.

**Changes to `src/mcp_server_xonsh/server.py`:**

1. **`create_server(workdir: str | None = None)`** — accepts the server-level workdir.
2. **`--workdir` CLI flag** — lets you launch e.g. `mcp-server-xonsh --workdir /path/to/project` regardless of the CWD used to start the server.
3. **`_resolve_cwd(cwd, default_cwd)`** — falls back to `default_cwd` (the server workdir) before `os.getcwd()` when `cwd` isn't provided.
4. **`execute_xonsh(..., default_cwd=...)`** — threads the workdir through so a per-call `cwd` still overrides the server default.

So with `--workdir /my/project`, a `run_xonsh` call with no `cwd` runs in `/my/project`, but passing an explicit `cwd` still wins. All 8 tests pass.
